county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care or services that was trauma informed and/or culturally competent.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
